children.hypothesis: Requiring a successful verification exit code and a freshly observed pass before any final message prevents reward-zero premature exits.
Requiring at least one observable workspace inspection and tool invocation before any final reply addresses reward-zero trials with no recorded agent execution.
Requiring the agent to confirm the expected output artifact exists on disk before final submission addresses reward-zero failures where no usable artifact was produced.
